articleTitle: Compact Directional Coupler with Different Input/Output Wave Resistances Line of Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The classical design of the directional coupler has four input/output transmission lines with wave resistances of 50 ohms, which does not allow them to be connected to devices with excellent resistance, for example, 75 ohms without matching devices. In this paper, a technique is proposed for obtaining a directional coupler with different wave resistances of input/output lines, which allows using such devices without additional matching devices if they are connected to lines with different resistances.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Band-Pass Filters Made Using SIW Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: SIW technologies are becoming more and more popular and relevant. It allows you to significantly reduce the weight and size parameters of the devices, and the accuracy of the devices is practically no different from full-size analogues. So In this paper, we will consider studies of filters of the 3rd, 5th and 7th orders, made using SIW technology. Computer models, theoretical calculations and their comparison with filters made according to these models are presented. The paper also presents a band-pass filter made in a multilayer design

articleTitle: Reflection Symmetrical Modal Filter on a Double-Sided PCB
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This paper considers the protection of electronic devices from the effects of ultrashort pulses by using modal filtering. This paper presents the first results of the study of a new configuration of a reflection symmetric (RS) modal filter (MF). The configuration of such an MF is formed by modifying the MF on a double-sided PCB with broad-side and edge coupling. The paper shows that when all conductors are equal in width, Pulses 3 and 4 overlap, which leads to an increase in amplitudes. However, the time intervals between these pulses can be increased by reducing the widths of the reference conductors and the distance between the signal and reference conductors. The difference of the per-unit-length mode delays can also be increased by increasing the widths of the signal conductors and the thickness of the substrate. For the best parameters, we present the attenuation results when the boundary conditions at the ends of all passive conductors were changed to short-circuit (SC) and open circuit (OC)). The maximum difference of the per-unit-length mode delays for Modes 2 and 1 was 0.644 ns/m, for Modes 3 and 2 it was 0.489 ns/m, and for Modes 4 and 3 it was 0.184 ns/m, respectively. A 4-time attenuation was achieved for the loads of 50 ohms at the ends of all conductors, and there was a 5-time attenuation for OC-SC.

articleTitle: Development of a Research Gyrotron Based Complex for Studying a Model of Secondary Electron Emission Using the New Additive Technology CMPS
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This paper presents a methodology for theoretical and experimental studies aimed at an urgent problem in the field of high-power microwave devices - refinement of the model of secondary electron emission from the surface of electrodes of vacuum sources of microwave radiation and the study of the properties of the electron flow in the field of electron-wave interaction. The necessary elemental base of the experimental setup is created on the basis of the new CMPS additive technology, which allows to produce unique copper products with a complex surface shape.

articleTitle: CMOS Operational Amplifier With Low Level of the Systematic Component of the Zero Offset Voltage
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Promising circuit design solutions for CMOS operational amplifiers (OAs) are studied, in which the systematic component of the zero offset voltage (V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">off</inf>) is improved with a change in the supply voltage. Computer modeling in the OrCAD environment and mathematical analysis made it possible to establish that the proposed OA circuits have high voltage gain values (up to 80 dB) and a low V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">off</inf> level (about 300 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mu \mathrm{V}$</tex>). The considered OAs can be used in differently analogue and analogue-digital interfaces (for example, in converter stabilizers, multivibrators, active filters, etc.), incl. when implemented on wide-gap semiconductors.

articleTitle: Investigation of a Cylindrical Dielectric Lens with Periodic Inclusions in the Form of Conducting Hollow Cylinders of Finite Length
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: A method for analyzing cylindrical dielectric lenses containing a photonic crystal formed by hollow conducting cylinders of finite length has been developed. It is shown that the dielectric filling with a dielectric constant close to unity has a noticeable effect on the focusing properties of the lens.

articleTitle: Total Blooming Effect in Active Elements of Gigawatt Terahertz Compressors
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Prospective three-mirror quasi-optical compressors with laser-driven switching open the way to reach gigawatt pulsed power in terahertz band. The compressor uses a Gaussian beam that can pass through the active element without significant reflection and loss at the stage of pumping. Such blooming of the active element can be provided with an optical interference minimum and/or the Brewster effect. Reaching gigawatt power level faces a challenge of minimizing power losses inside the compressor, when even the difference between a Gaussian beam and a plane wave really matters. A novel approach of using the wave equation instead of the parabolic equation to solve the problem of a Gaussian beam propagation through an arbitrary stratified media with a complex permittivity helps us to avoid artifacts of nonzero electric field divergence. Using an advanced Fourier transformation based numerical model of integration in a wave vector space with an algorithm of lattice truncation, the study estimates and reveals a significant difference between a plane wave and a corresponding Gaussian beam that might be visible and confirmed in the near future experiments.

articleTitle: Time Response Analysis for Reflection Symmetric Meander Lines Using Quasistatic and Electrodynamic Approaches
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The article discusses the problem of ensuring noise immunity of radioelectronic equipment (REE) from the ultra-wideband (UWB) interference. We consider the protection of REE from UWB pulse using reflection symmetric meander lines (ML) and show the simulation results of such structure with one, two, and three turns. The article shows time responses at the ML output calculated using quasistatic and electrodynamic approaches with losses. The findings are in agreement, indicating the accurate use of numerical methods. Calculated deviations of the amplitude values can be explained by differences in approaches, various considerations of the frequency dependence <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\varepsilon_{r}$</tex> and tgδ, and the effect of losses on radiation, which are taken into account in the electrodynamic approach. The results of the voltage waveforms comparison confirm the appearance of combinational pulses, which are revealed only with lossless quasistatic simulations. This fact highlights the significance of structures with partial or complete asymmetry. Since decomposition pulse sequence may contain combinational pulses, the energy can additionally be distributed over time. Thus, it is possible to minimize the maximum of the amplitudes of the mode pulses.

articleTitle: Method for Increasing the Speed of Operational Amplifier Based on “Folded” Cascode
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Prospective circuits of fast-speed operational amplifiers (Op-Amps) based on a “folded” cascode implemented on silicon bipolar transistors, as well as GaAs JFET and GaAs p-<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$n$</tex>-<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$p$</tex> BJT transistors are proposed. Computer modeling of Op-Amps in the LTspice environment showed that the Op-Amp's open-loop gain exceeds 60 dB, and their slew rate (SR) reaches hundreds of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{V}/\boldsymbol{\mu \mathrm{s}}$</tex>. The developed operational amplifiers can be recommended for use in analog front-end, used in detectors of various physical quantities for high energy physics, space tools and medicine.

articleTitle: Research and Modeling of Flexible Bending of UHF RFID Tags
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Simulation of RFID tag AZ-9654 with known topology was carried out. To study the electrodynamic parameters, several states of the tag were simulated: basic, as well as with flexible bends (on cylindrical and rectangular surfaces). The results of the study show changes in the electrodynamic characteristics (radiation pattern, S11 parameter, VSWR) with flexible deformations of the relative base state and the declared characteristics. In turn, the results of the study make it possible to analyze changes in electrodynamic parameters (including negative ones) and take them into account when designing antennas for RFID tags.

articleTitle: Circuitry Features of the Gallium Arsenide Operational Amplifier and its Basic Functional Units
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The article discusses the features of the construction of gallium arsenide (GaAs) operational amplifiers (OpAmps), as well as their input, intermediate and output stages. OpAmp circuit solutions have been developed that provide low values of the zero offset voltage systematic component (lower than 1 μV) and an increased open-loop voltage gain (155 dB). Mathematical analysis of the main parameters of OpAmp is performed. The results of computer modelling of an OpAmp based on combined GaAs manufacturing process by the OJSC “Minsk Research Institute of Radio Materials”, which implement n-channel FET and p-n-p bipolar transistors, are presented. The GaAs OpAmps considered in the article can be used in various analogue transducer and ADCs (signal transducers, active filters, active front end etc.), including their implementation for the microwave ranges.

articleTitle: Automated System for Lithium-Ion Batteries Study Based on Relaxation Processes Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This work is dedicated to the experimental testing of one of the methods for diagnosing lithium batteries in various modes of its operation. This method is based on the analysis of transient characteristics caused by an intermittent change in the load in the circuit. A laboratory setup for research has been developed. The article presents the block diagram of the facility. The temperature dependence of the parameters of the second-order equivalent circuit of lithium batteries has been studied.

articleTitle: Experimental Investigation of Magnetostatic Waves Excitation by Coaxial Transducers in Yttrium Iron Garnet Films
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Excitation of magnetostatic waves in a yttrium iron garnet film by a short-circuited SMA transducer, whose thin linear jumper connects the central conductor to an external grounded coaxial cylinder, is considered. The frequency dependences of the return loss for yttrium iron garnet films of different thickness with different orientation of the transducer thin linear jumper relative to the applied external constant magnetic field direction are measured. The cases of the presence and absence of a distance between the transducer and the film are investigated.

articleTitle: Cooling Systems for Power Supply Elements: Overview and Calculation Method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This article provides an overview of the cooling methods for modern microwave amplifiers. The object of research is a microwave module that combines a semiconductor amplifier, a vacuum amplifier and a power supply system. A technique for modeling and calculating thermal effects on a microwave and a semiconductor module, as well as thermal calculations for the operation of an amplifier, is presented. This technique will evaluate the efficiency of the cooling system.

articleTitle: Narrow-Band Waveguide Filter on Complex Resonant Diaphragms
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: An Electrodynamic Analysis and Synthesis of a Waveguide Narrowband Band-Pass Filter on Thin Resonant Diaphragms Has Been Carried Out. the Aperture of the Diaphragm Is a Combination of a Rectangular Window, Symmetrically Arranged e-Shaped Cutouts and Rectangular Stripes Along the Entire Length of the Diaphragm. the Band-Pass Filter of the Third Order Is Made on a Rectangular Waveguide Wr-137. This Filter Has Been Modeled and Also Manufactured. the Amplitude-Frequency Response of the Manufactured Prototype Filter Was Measured and Compared With the Simulation Results.

articleTitle: Conformal Antenna Array for Gynecology for Medical Microwave Radiothermograph
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The purpose of the work is to select and substantiate the design of a conformal antenna array for a medical microwave radiothermograph to be used for gynecology. The results of calculations confirming the possibility of manufacturing a conformal antenna array for a microwave radiothermograph are presented. The optimal dimensions of the conformal antenna array and its components were determined in the course of the work. The antenna has an antenna diameter of 18 mm, and the total length of the antenna is 180 mm. The antenna is designed in such a way as to detect the pathology of the pelvic organs of small sizes, located at a depth of 4–18 mm or deeper), as well as for temperature monitoring of small ones with an error of ±0.3 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\circ$</tex> C. The use of a conformal antenna array as part of a microwave radiothermograph has a high potential in gynecology, for pregnancy planning, primary diagnosis of cancer, monitoring of biological indicators.

articleTitle: Diffusion and Mobility of Charged Particles of a Gas-Discharge Plasma in a Transverse Magnetic Field
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This article discusses the calculated values of diffusion and mobility of charge carriers, which characterize the motion of electrons and ions in a low-temperature gas-discharge plasma of inert gases. These parameters make it possible to describe the motion of electrons and ions in a gas-discharge plasma over long (compared to the free path time) times in the presence of an external electric field and without it. Graphs of the mobility of charge carriers in a magnetic field are obtained and analyzed. The article calculates the minimum values of the magnetic field of inert gases, at which low-temperature plasma becomes homogeneous.

articleTitle: Development and Modernization of Chamber Type Defroster with Microwave Power up to 12 kW
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The need to create chamber-type microwave defrosters with a capacity of up to 400 kg/hour was been shown. The results of domestic chamber microwave defroster DMK-10 upgrading with a microwave power of up to 12 kW are presented. The working chamber of the defroster operates in multimode mode with antenna nodes of microwave power. The installation is powered by four magnetrons magnetron M-176 with a microwave power of up to 3 kW at a frequency of 915 MHz. Upgraded antenna nodes for entering magnetron power are placed in the upper surface of the working chamber and on the back wall under the rotating loading table. This arrangement of antennas are ensures uniformity of product warming. Operation comparison of previously existing and upgraded antennas is given. The performed tuning of the antenna power input nodes allowed us to obtain the values of the VSWR and transition attenuation coefficients between the antennas required for magnetrons operation. The ergonomics of loading meat and fish blocks was improved. The design of upgraded defroster is changed. Studies of the modernized installation operation in the conditions of food industrial production are carried out on the territory of the customers. Experiment show that the operational characteristics of the upgraded defroster correspond to the parameters of the foreign defrosters.

articleTitle: The Screen Thickness Effect on Characteristics and Parameters of a Symmetrical Slot Line
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Based on the finite element method, the parameters and characteristics of such a waveguide structure as a symmetrical slot line are calculated and analyzed. Variants of a symmetrical slot line with metal screens of various thicknesses are considered. The results of numerical calculation of the parameters and characteristics of the line under consideration are obtained.

articleTitle: LED Internal Quantum Efficiency Meter
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: A structural schematic and operating principle of the internal quantum efficiency meter of InGaN LEDs are presented. The operation of the device is based on the method of measuring the internal quantum efficiency, which consists in measuring the emission power and the 3 dB frequency of the LED electroluminescence at two currents in the range from 10 μA to 100 μA and calculating the value of the internal quantum efficiency according to the given formula. The results of measurements of the internal quantum efficiency of various types of commercial LEDs are presented. It is shown that the distribution of LEDs by the value of the internal quantum efficiency is more uniform than the distribution by the value of the emission power, which is explained by the difference in the light extraction efficiency from the active region of the LEDs of the studied samples.

articleTitle: On the Possibility of Creation of the Mobil Resotrode-accelerator
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The possibilities of creating a new electro-vacuum device - a mobile resotrode accelerator are considered. This device is supposed to be used as the basis of an accelerator complex for disinfection of bulk products. It is shown that such a device can be developed based on the concept of a resotrode with 0-regeneration. The analysis of such a device with an output beam energy of 2 MeV and powered by a standard diesel generator is carried out. Calculations of the main parameters are carried out and a sketch of the device is presented.

articleTitle: Photonic Crystal Resonators with a Tree Structure of Resonant Elements
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The article presents the results of three-dimensional numerical simulation of a photonic crystal resonator with tree-like resonant elements. The frequency spectrum was studied and the main electrodynamic parameters of resonators were determined in the range up to 32 GHz. The effect of the photonic-crystal grating pitch on the frequency spectrum of the resonator has been studied. The investigated resonator can be used in klystron-type multi-beam devices operating as amplifiers, oscillators, and frequency multipliers in the X-, Ku-, and K-bands.

articleTitle: Development of Block Conveyor Installation for Microwave Processing
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The work is devoted to the development of universal modular-block platform for creation of installations with microwave processing. The developed platform is planned to be used for installations of microwave and combined convective drying, thermal disinfection and swelling and calcination of various materials. The development of universal microwave heating unit consisted from 6 magnetrons with a power of 850 watts at a frequency of 2450 MHz has been carried out. The design of the block allows it to be adapted to the conveyor parameters and to processing of various organic and inorganic materials. The design of 6 flat horn antennas assembly is developed and manufactured. The electrodynamic characteristics of horn antennas are measured and adjusted using a vector circuit analyzer. Microwave processing block has been manufactured, including an antenna assembly, magnetrons with power sources and cooling and control systems. Tunnel section is developed to ensure electromagnetic safety. The microwave processing block showed high performance characteristics during tests on conveyor system for drying organic material. The created modular-block platform of the conveyor installation of microwave processing makes it possible to comprehensively solve most technological problems.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Electrodynamic Parameters of a Three-Gap Multi-Beam Klystron Resonator with Planar Strip Conductors on a Dielectric Substrate
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: A three-gap multi-beam prismatic klystron resonator with planar stripe resonant elements on a dielectric substrate was investigated and presented in this paper. The results of electrodynamic simulation were obtained using the numerical finite difference method in the time domain. The main electrodynamic parameters (a resonant frequency, a quality factor, and a characteristic impedance) were determined for the main modes of the resonator. The multifrequency mode of operation and the possibility of operating the resonator at multiple resonant frequencies were considered. Such resonator can be used in low-voltage klystron-type devices operating as amplifiers, oscillators, and frequency multipliers.

articleTitle: Effect of Wafers Processing by Low Doses $\gamma$-Radiation on the Structure of Porous Layers GaAs
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The results of the study of the structure of gallium arsenide wafers and porous layers GaAs by high-resolution X-ray diffraction (XRD) are discussed. The wafers GaAs were previously subjected to treatment with low doses of y-irradiation (10, 30, 40, 200 kR). Porous layers GaAs by electrochemical etching in galvanostatic mode were obtained. The morphology of the surface and the end chips of porous layers by scanning electron microscopy (SEM) were studied. The diffraction patterns made it possible to determine the change in the crystallographic parameters of the substrates and porous layers GaAs as a function of the irradiation dose of the wafers.

articleTitle: Physical Features of Wide-Band Metamaterial Based on a Microstrip Meander Line With a Slot Shield
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The work presents a method of analytical calculation of microstrip meander-line complex resistance. Construction of a frequency-selective structure, formed by a slot line and microstrip meander-line is described. Using the construction as an example a method of calculation of complex resistance of a microstrip meander-line, which is located not above a perfectly conducting ground plane, but above an impedance surface is explained. Results of described structure complex resistance calculation are presented and their comprising with results of measurement of the structure sample is provided. Calculated and measured results are in a good correspondence.

articleTitle: Prospects of New Borophene/GaN and Borophene/ZnO van der Waals Heterostructures in Nanoelectronic Devices
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: In this paper, we present atomistic models of novel vertical heterostructures formed by 2D monolayers of buckled borophene with triangular crystal lattice, gallium nitride (GaN), and zinc oxide (ZnO). An in silico study of the features of atomic structure and electrical properties for these models is carried out. It is found that the constructed atomistic models of borophene/GaN and borophene/ZnO vertical heterostructures are characterized by energetically stability and have a gapless band structure. The presence of the current anisotropy in the van der Waals heterostructures of this type is revealed. It is shown that during the formation of layered heterostructures, the charge is transferred from borophene sheet to GaN and ZnO monolayers. Based on the calculation results, it is predicted that borophene/GaN and borophene/ZnO van der Waals heterostructures have good prospects for use as functional materials for development of nanoelectronic devices, in particular, as Schottky contacts.

articleTitle: High Power Multibeam Klystrons Using Resonators with Metamaterial
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Physical principles of output power limitation in low-voltage multibeam klystrons are considered. It is demonstrated that metamaterial consisting of array of metal inductive inserts and located in the cavity's interaction region makes possible significant increasing of phase velocity of transversal wave in the gap. This reveals the opportunity to enhance uniformity of the rf field interacting with the beams in the gap, interaction region diameter, beams current and power of the klystron without cathode voltage increase. Resonators in <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{S}$</tex> and Ka bands are analyzed.

articleTitle: Modernization of a Magnetron with a Long Anode
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The results of modernization of a magnetron with a long anode are presented. The results of modeling the S-parameters of a new rejector filter design are presented. The thermal problem of filter heating has been solved. Changed pumping technology

articleTitle: Calculating of the Microgrid Inverters Reliability
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The paper proposes a method for calculating of the reliability of inverters as part of microgrid systems. This method makes it possible to estimate total failure rate and mean time between failures of inverters. Reliability indicators of several variants of three-phase inverters are calculated using the proposed technique. A comparative analysis of obtained results was carried out.

articleTitle: Study of Multiple-Beam Sub-THz Traveling-Wave Tube with Meander-Line Slow-Wave Structure
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Development of miniature sources of coherent sub-THz radiation is an important task of contemporary vacuum electronics. Traveling-wave tube (TWT) is especially attractive as it combines high output power and broad bandwidth. In this article, the results of the development of TWT with a meander-line slow-wave structure (SWS) with several beam tunnels for a multiple sheet electron beam are presented. The V-band (50–70 GHz) SWSs are designed and simulated. The results of the beam-wave interaction simulation are presented as well.

articleTitle: Electromotive Force Generation under Spin Waves Propagation in YIG/n-InSb and YIG/Pt Microstructures
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Both inverse spin Hall effect (“interface”) and electron drag by magnons (“bulk”) mechanisms of the electromotive force generation by travelling magnetostatic surface (MSSW) and backward volume (MSBVW) waves in YIG/Pt and YIG/n-InSb microstructures are studied. It is shown that “interface mechanism” plays the main role in YIG/ Pt bilayers, while for YIG/n-InSb structures, electron drag by magnons dominates. Giant oscillations of the voltage caused by inverse spin Hall effect were observed in YIG/Pt structures at frequencies corresponding to resonance interactions of MSSW with the volume exchange modes.

articleTitle: Reflective and/or Absorbing Ultrathin Multifunctional Materials From Black Silicon Nanowires, Iron Oxide and Nickel Nanoparticles
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This work continues and develops an approach to predicting (calculating) and modeling the properties of new absorbing (reflecting) materials on flexible sheets. We consider a multifunctional material on a flexible sheet with partially ordered arrays of nanowires and spherical nanoparticles. To calculate the effective properties of a multifunctional material on a flexible sheet with partially ordered arrays of silicon nanowires and spherical metallic nickel and/or iron oxide nanoparticles, the “effective medium theory” approach was used. The effective complex permittivity, refractive and absorption indices, reflectance, as well as the effect of saturation with nanoparticles on the effective absorbing and reflecting properties of the multifunctional material were calculated and investigated.

articleTitle: Leontovich Boundary Condition Implementation into Finite Difference Time Domain Method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The algorithm accounting for finite conductivity of metal surfaces is proposed. The algorithm is based on inserting a lumped element containing a resistor and inductor, into each mesh cell contacting with a metal surface. Testing of the algorithm showed its high accuracy for metal conductivity more than 300 S/m.

articleTitle: Microwave Cyclotron Protective Devices
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The basic principles of operation and design features of microwave cyclotron protective devices for radar receivers are described, the electrical parameters and characteristics are presented. Their advantages over other types of protective devices are shown.

Author Keywords: transverse interaction with an electron beam

articleTitle: High Power X-Band Klystron: Simulation and Experiment
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The paper presents the results of numerical simulation of a X-band multibeam klystron. An analysis is given of a new principle for constructing the interaction space, which makes it possible to provide record efficiency values without the use of second-harmonic resonators, and the results of modeling electrodynamic characteristics and transporting an intense electron beam are presented. The results of an experimental study of the developed 25-beam klystron KIU-283, with a peak power of 3.0 MW at a frequency of 9300 MHz with an efficiency of 57% are given.

articleTitle: Room Temperature Gas Sensing Properties of Porous Silicon for Chemiresistive Organic Vapor Sensors
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: In this work, we studied the sensitivity of porous silicon structures obtained by electrochemical etching to vapors of polar organic compounds.Current-voltage characteristics (CVCs) of the samples were obtained in the presence of vapors of various concentrations of acetone, ethanol, and isopropanol at room temperature. Based on these CVCs, the dependences of the sensitivity on the applied voltage were calculated and analyzed.

articleTitle: Measuring the Level of Radiated Emissions from PCBs with Modal Reservation before and after Failure
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: In this paper, the levels of radiated emissions from printed circuit boards with modal reservation are estimated before and after failures. Four boards prototypes (without modal reservation, and with modal reservation before and after short and open circuit failures) were manufactured to experimentally study their features. A laboratory model of a classical TEM-cell was used to measure the frequency dependences up to 2 GHz of the voltage amplitude levels at its central conductor for all boards. The measured results obtained after failures were compared to those obtained before them. It was revealed that in general the level of radiated emissions for the board with modal reservation is lower than for the board without it even after failures, except at some frequencies of the studied domain, due to the frequency shifting. The study confirms the possibility of using the modal reservation layout and tracing approach for both ensuring electromagnetic compatibility and improving the reliability of radioelectronic devices.

articleTitle: Experimental Study of the Sterilization Capabilities of Various Methods of Microwave Exposure to Medical Instruments
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The article is devoted to the results of experimental studies of the effectiveness of various methods of processing medical instruments using microwave radiation.

articleTitle: Hyperboloid Monotron
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: It is proposed to use projections in the form of a hyperboloid surface at the end of the interaction area to increase the electron efficiency of a planar monotron. It is shown that the hyperboloid surface is an effective concentrator of the electric field. Numerical modelling has determined the normalized values of the size of the interaction area and the electrical regime, providing the values of the electron efficiency for the first zone of 35%, for the second - 38% and for the third - 40%.

articleTitle: Generator with a Double-Gap Cavity in the W Range and a Sheet Electron Beam
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: 3D numerical simulation methods were used to study the model of a monotron-type self-oscillator with a double-gap cavity and a sheet electron beam. The main electronic and electrodynamic parameters of the resonator and the output characteristics of the oscillator were calculated. The maximum efficiency value was 5.17%, and the maximum microwave output power reached 1.16 kW at a frequency of 95 GHz.

articleTitle: Terahertz-to-Infrared Up-Conversion by Plasmonic-Enhanced Sum Frequency Generation in Graphene Gratings
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The tunable parametric up-conversion of terahertz (THz) to mid-infrared (MIR) frequencies via the third-order nonlinear process of nondegenerate four-wave mixing in graphene gratings is investigated by solving the nonlinear boundary diffraction problem using the developed numerical-analytical approach. First, we designed the linear THz, IR absorption spectra of graphene gratings to support resonances of surface plasmon polaritons (SPP) modes in the THz, MIR ranges by choosing the pump <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$f_{1}$</tex> and signal <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$f$</tex> <inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> frequencies equal to the resonant frequencies of the fundamental and higher-order SPP modes. The results of mathematical modeling of nonlinear spectra, i.e., the intensity of the parametric emission of transmitted and reflected waves at the sum frequency <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{f}_{3}=2f_{1}+f_{2}$</tex> in the MIR range for various chemical potential <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mu_{c}$</tex> in the graphene ribbon gratings are obtained. It is shown the enhancement of efficiency of up-conversion of THz to MIR frequencies by several orders when the graphene gratings are resonantly excited at SPP mode resonance frequencies by the signal and pump waves.

articleTitle: Design of Lange Coupler and Marchand Balun Based on the Wire Over Dielectric Over Ground Plane Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This article deals with new Lange coupler and Marchand balun based on a novel coupled line section. The coupled line section is differ with conductor isolation and increased height to width ratio. A design method for novel Lange coupler and Marchand balun is proposed. The design method was verified through electromagnetic simulation and experimental verification.

Author Keywords: wire over dielectric over ground plane transmission line

articleTitle: Method for Detecting the Breakdown of the Average Change in the Sequence of the Current Values of the Coefficient of Thermal Activity of the Polymer Material
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Detecting a desired signal from noise is one of the urgent problems of signal processing. In this paper a new method is proposed for detecting the breakdown of the average change in the sequence of current values of the thermal activity coefficient for a polymer material during thermal exposure, including using microwave radiation. The proposed method is very effective and easy to implement in practice.

articleTitle: Measuring Complex for Photoelectric Diagnostics of Semiconductor Structures
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The paper presents a block diagram and describes the principle of operation of a measuring complex for photoelectric diagnostics of semiconductor structures with local photoexcitation. The complex allows scanning the working surface of a semiconductor structure with laser radiation, as well as detecting recombination radiation from the surface of a semiconductor structure in the near infrared wavelength region. The results of experimental tests of the complex on a four-quadrant photodiode are presented. The degree of inhomogeneity of the photoresponse can be used to assess the quality of the structure under study and the spread in the sensitivity of the elements of the photodiode under study.

articleTitle: Current Distortion Reduction of a Substation for the Power Supply of a Frequency Controlled Gas Cooling Plant
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Gas cooling is an essential part of technological process when gas is transported via main pipelines. Keeping gas temperatures after its compression is implemented at gas-cooling units; each unit consists of several gas air-coolers. Equipping gas-cooling units with fans controlled by variable frequency drive leads to the need to solve the problem of electromagnetic compatibility in the power supply system of the compressor station. The problem is exacerbated when the power source is an autonomous energy source, for example, a gas turbine power plant. The article describes the solutions of this problem; also, a substation scheme that can be used to create new facilities for trunk transport and gas storage is proposed and investigated.

articleTitle: Virtual Laboratory Work for Studying the Spectrum of Radio Signals
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Computer models of spectrum analyzer and signal modulators have been created.. These models are included in the virtual laboratory. A laboratory work has been created to study the spectrum of modulated radio signals. The interface of the spectrum analyzer model is completely similar to the real device.

articleTitle: Stand for Measuring the Parameters of the Current-Voltage Characteristics of Power Transistors
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Power transistors in electrical energy converters operate in the mode of electrical switches. Due to the presence of various constructive and parasitic reactances in the devices, when switching transistors, impulse overvoltages occur, usually exceeding the voltage of the source from which the converter is powered. These impulse voltages are applied to the electrodes of the transistors. If the overvoltage level exceeds the blocking capabilities of the transistor, then it will be broken. To exclude such a possibility, when designing converter devices, it is necessary to have information about the limiting value of the blocking voltage of the transistors used. The article provides a stand for measuring the parameters of the current-voltage characteristics of power transistors, which allows you to form a voltage value of up to 2kV and measure the leakage current in the range of 10μA-2mA.

articleTitle: Ways to Improve the Magneto-Optical Properties of Materials for Measuring Systems Based on the Faraday Effect
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: An analysis of studies of the magneto-optical properties of promising materials is carried out in order to establish the possibility of their use in Faraday devices. The factors influencing the measured value of the Verde constant, which must be considered in practice, are established. The results of a study on the synthesis of new magneto-optical media in the near and mid-IR wavelength ranges based on rare-earth oxides, which can be used in the creation of fiber-optic sensors for remote monitoring of magnetic fields, are analyzed.

Author Keywords: ways to increase the Verde constant

articleTitle: Issues of Focusing Electron Flows in Devices with Long-Term Interaction
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The article discusses known methods of focusing electron beams in microwave devices of the O-type TWT type, stability conditions. More and more important are the questions concerning the uniform magnetic field and the reversible magnetic field of magnetic focusing systems. The problem of choice and the necessary zone of stability of the electron beam according to the Mathieu equation is touched upon.

articleTitle: Software: the Influence of Technological Deviations of the Geometric Parameters of Permanent Magnets on the Electron Beam Stability
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The article presents a mathematical model for assessing the influence of technological deviations of the geometric parameters of permanent magnets on the TWT parameters. The technique proposes to produce through the assessment of the influence of deviations on the magnetic coefficient, as well as the sensitivity of the magnetic field according to the corresponding geometric parameter of the annular magnet. A computer program is presented that implements the described methodology for assessing the impact of technological deviations.

articleTitle: Thermal Resistance Meter for High Power Semiconductor Devices
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The article presents the results of development of semiconductor devices thermal resistance hardware-software measurement complex. The complex based of the modulation method, using device under test (DUT) heating using current PWM-pulses under harmonic law. This method allows to measure a thermal resistance components related to the specificities of the heat flow in the DUT. Show the principal possibility of measuring the thermal resistance of the transition layer, using which the die is mounted to the base of the semiconductor device case.

articleTitle: Formation of Structural Diagrams of Measuring Instruments for Fire-Fighting Monitoring of Natural Territories
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The purpose of the research is to propose block diagrams of the elements of the measuring complex, which is designed for fire-fighting monitoring of natural areas. Four basic elements schemes of the measuring complex have been formed. The elements include sensors, blocks for primary information processing, blocks for providing information exchange, blocks for autonomous power supply. These elements are designed to collect and transmit information about the state of controlled areas. The topology of the measuring complex is based on the basis of Mesh network principles. Information about the state of controlled areas is sent to the Web-server. On this server, the received information is processed. Based on the results of information processing, recommendations are formed that are intended to provide control actions on certain sections of the controlled territory. The main task of control actions is to reduce the level of fire danger or increase the efficiency of preparatory measures to eliminate the fire. Cellular, trunking, or satellite communications networks are used to interact with information collection devices with a Web-Server. In some cases, an unmanned aerial vehicle may be used to collect information.

articleTitle: Reflection and Transmission Properties of a Rectangular Waveguide with Capacitive Post
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The propagation and scattering characteristics of S/C-band standard rectangular waveguide WR187 with a metal capacitive post are investigated numerically by means of a 3-D finite element model. A preliminary testing of this model was carried out using experimental data taken from the literature. The occurrence of single transmission zeros in the frequency response was found for some values of the post height.

articleTitle: Antialising Low-Pass Filters of the Sallen-Key Family on Gallium Arsenide Voltage repeaters for Working with High-Speed ADC
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The issues of constructing gallium arsenide (GaAs) voltage follower (VF) and low-pass antialising filters (LPF) based on them for switching on high-speed ADC at the input are considered. Circuit solutions of VF have been developed that provide small values of the systematic component of the zero offset voltage, including under conditions of radiation and low-temperature influences. The results obtained of computer modeling of the LPF based on combined GaAs technological processes implementing n-channel JFET and p-n-p bipolar transistors are presented.

articleTitle: The Use of Microwave Multipactor Discharge for the Diagnostics of High-Voltage Insulators Technical Condition
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The results of theoretical and practical study of a microwave multipactor discharge in the round cylindrical cavity resonator for diagnosing of high-voltage insulators technical condition are presented. The analysis of the resonator main characteristics, which determine the condition for the occurrence of a multipactor discharge, taking into account the geometric dimensions and electrophysical properties of the resonator, is given. On the example of the porcelain insulator as a dielectric material, the peculiarities of the interaction mechanism of the standing wave in a resonator with the surface of the diagnosed product placed in it are revealed. The calculation of the microwave radiation absorption coefficient by a multipactor discharge on a dielectric plate is given as the main information parameter of the insulator defectiveness degree. Experiments have established the possibility of the insulator state diagnosing by means of a multipactor in the absence of external static fields.

articleTitle: Ammonia Recognition at Different Humidity with a Graphene Sensors Array Modified by a Focused Ion Beam
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Graphene sensor structures were modified by a focused ion beam (FIB) with a selected distance between the points in the central area crossing the channel with a different exposure time per point. An effect of FIB exposure on structural properties in graphene was evaluated by Raman spectroscopy and electrical measurements. The resistive sensor response (SR) of the selected sensors towards water vapor and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{\text{NH}_{3}}$</tex> exposure outperforms the known results for modified graphene with other techniques. The set of structures demonstrates a specific SR behavior due to the implementation of different gas sensitivity mechanisms when changing the FIB modification time: graphene with a short modification time demonstrates an increase in the SR to NH3 with rising relative humidity (RH), while the SR of graphene with a long modification time decreases with rising RH. Along with the opposite changes in the resistance at SR to water vapor, it allows to correctly determine the concentration of NH3 at different levels of RH at room temperature by the array of only three sensors using linear discriminant analysis (LDA).
